Variants.Content: Woods, passes and crossings offer defence choices. Fritigern war still needs eastern warnings; followers and dependants require grain, making long concentration costly.

Thervingian woods, rivers and passes offer different defences. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Fritigern war still needs eastern warnings and food.
